e6e7c69329779e7b.description: About the Role As an Investor Relations (IR) , you will play a critical role in managing the companys relationships with investors, analysts, shareholders, and financial stakeholders. You will act as the key bridge between the companys leadership and the investment community, ensuring transparent, consistent, and accurate communication of EaseMyTrips business strategy, financial performance, and long-term vision. This role is central to strengthening market confidence, enhancing shareholder value, and supporting EMTs positioning as a trusted, governance-driven, publicly listed company. You will work closely with senior leadership, finance, legal, and strategy teams to align investor messaging with business objectives and regulatory requirements. Role & Responsibilities Investor Communication Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive investor relations strategy aligned with EaseMyTrips business goals, growth plans, and capital market expectations. Earnings & Financial Communication: Manage quarterly and annual earnings communication, including investor presentations, earnings call scripts, result decks, press releases, and FAQs. Analyst & Investor Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with institutional investors, mutual funds, sovereign funds, analysts, brokers, and rating agencies. Regulatory & Compliance Communication: Ensure all investor communications comply with SEBI, stock exchange, and disclosure regulations, working closely with legal and compliance teams. Market Intelligence & Feedback: Track investor sentiment, analyst reports, peer performance, and market trends; provide actionable insights and feedback to senior management. Investor Meetings & Roadshows: Organize and manage investor meetings, conference calls, non-deal roadshows (NDRs), investor conferences, and site visits. Crisis & Sensitive Communication: Support leadership during periods of market volatility, negative news, or sensitive disclosures with well-crafted, compliant messaging. Board & Leadership Support: Prepare briefing notes, Q&A documents, and talking points for promoters, CEO, CFO, and board members for investor interactions. IR Content Ownership: Own all investor-facing materials including investor presentations, fact sheets, annual reports (investor sections), and website IR pages. Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor stock performance, shareholding patterns, analyst coverage, and investor outreach metrics; provide regular IR reports to leadership. Preferred Candidate Profile Listed Company IR Experience: Proven experience in investor relations, equity research, corporate finance, or financial communications, preferably in a listed company environment. Strong Capital Market Understanding: Deep understanding of equity markets, valuation drivers, financial statements, and investor expectations. Investor & Analyst Network: Established relationships with institutional investors, analysts, funds, and financial media. Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to clearly articulate complex financial and strategic information to diverse stakeholder groups. Regulatory Knowledge: Strong familiarity with SEBI regulations, disclosure norms, earnings processes, and corporate governance standards. Analytical & Financial Acumen: Comfortable analyzing financial performance, peer benchmarking, and market data to support investor narratives. Calm Under Pressure: Ability to manage sensitive situations, market rumors, and high-stakes disclosures with composure and clarity. Detail-Oriented & Structured: High attention to detail with strong documentation, reporting, and follow-up discipline. Cross-Functional Collaborator: Experience working closely with finance, legal, strategy, PR, and senior leadership teams. High Integrity & Confidentiality: Demonstrated professionalism in handling price-sensitive and confidential information. .

Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

We're the team that keeps airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our tech and communication innovations are the secret behind the success of the world’s air travel industry.

You'll find us at 95% of international hubs. We partner closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients, each with their own unique needs and challenges. Our goal is to find fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to make their operations run like clockwork. Want to be a part of something big? Are you ready to love your job? The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.

About The Role & Team

As a Financial Data Analyst, you will support our financial analytics team through hands-on data analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and data-quality activities. You will work closely with finance stakeholders, senior analysts, and IT teams to maintain and enhance reporting solutions and provide reliable, timely analytical support.

This role is suited to someone with a strong foundation in SQL and Power BI who enjoys working closely with data, collaborating with business users, and continuously improving reporting systems.

What You’ll Do

Power BI Report Support & Development

• Maintain and enhance existing Power BI dashboards and reports used in financial analysis.
• Assist in building new visuals and reports based on business requirements from finance and other departments.

SQL Data Integration & Analysis

• Write and optimize SQL queries to retrieve and transform financial data from various sources.
• Support the integration of new data into existing reporting structures, ensuring consistency and accuracy.

Data Quality & Monitoring

• Monitor scheduled data refreshes and troubleshoot data load issues.
• Perform data validation and cleansing to ensure accurate reporting.

Documentation & Support

• Maintain up-to-date documentation of datasets, data models, and report structures.
• Provide ad hoc analytical support to stakeholders in finance, ensuring quick turnaround for BaU requests.

Collaboration

• Work closely with senior analysts, finance stakeholders, and IT teams to understand reporting needs.
• Contribute to ongoing efforts to standardize and improve reporting processes.

Qualifications

ABOUT YOUR SKILLS

• Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 2–3 years of experience in a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst role.
• Solid SQL skills, with experience writing queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
• Working knowledge of Power BI, including building and modifying reports, DAX, Power Query, and data models.
• Understanding of financial datasets or interest in developing domain knowledge in finance.
• Familiarity with data quality practices and troubleshooting data issues.
• Exposure to Agile ways of working and tools like Azure DevOps is a plus.
• Clear communication skills and willingness to engage with both technical and business stakeholders.
• Strong team player with a collaborative mindset, ready to support and learn from more experienced team members.
• Detail-oriented and analytical, with the ability to spot issues in data and resolve them effectively.
• Comfortable working in an environment with shifting priorities and multiple concurrent tasks.
• Proactive and eager to improve Power BI and SQL skills in a practical business setting.

What We Offer

We’re all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We’re really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team’s needs)

⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans.

🌎 Flex Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world.

🌿Employee Wellbeing: We’ve got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health – a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

🚀Professional Development: Level up your skills with our training platforms, including LinkedIn Learning!

🙌🏽 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status.
